item.title: Diabetic nephropathy shows severe biochemical abnormalities
item.description: Chronic diabetes mellitus is marked by hyperglycemia and metabolic dysfunction, increasing the risk of complications such as nephropathy.

item.title: Fermentation breakthrough makes plant-based proteins more appealing
item.description: Off-putting smells can make even the healthiest of foods unpalatable.

item.title: Review compares surgical and neurostimulation outcomes in temporal lobe epilepsy
item.description: Temporal lobe epilepsy (TLE) is the most common form of focal epilepsy, affecting a significant proportion of patients who develop drug-resistant epilepsy.

item.title: ARVCF gene deletion leads to abnormalities in reward behavior
item.description: The ventral tegmental area (VTA) is a key brain region for dopamine production and the regulation of reward-related behaviors.

item.title: Global trends shape progress in cell and gene therapies
item.description: Cell and gene therapies, or CGT, have come a long way since they were first introduced. In the last few decades, both cell therapy -- the transplantation of living cells -- and gene therapy -- the use of genetic material to modify cell functions -- have been increasingly incorporated into clinical practice.

item.title: Honeysuckle compounds target key inflammatory signaling pathways
item.description: Announcing a new publication for Acta Materia Medica journal. Inflammation is a complex biological response essential for tissue repair in acute settings, yet chronic dysregulation contributes to progressive tissue damage and the pathogenesis of numerous diseases.

item.title: Attachment insecurity and materialism drive phubbing in relationships
item.description: New research reveals how attachment insecurity and materialistic values fuel 'phubbing' in romantic relationships.

item.title: US drinking water kiosks sometimes contain elevated lead levels
item.description: After high-profile water crises like the one in Flint, Michigan, some Americans distrust the safety of tap water, choosing to purchase drinking water from freestanding water vending machines or kiosks.

item.title: Universal famine thresholds may mask unfolding starvation
item.description: Recent global crises have exposed the limits of a universal mortality threshold for declaring famine-an approach that can obscure how famine actually unfolds across different populations.

item.title: Vitamin A and thyroid hormones in the retina shape fetal vision
item.description: Humans develop sharp vision during early fetal development thanks to an interplay between a vitamin A derivative and thyroid hormones in the retina, Johns Hopkins University scientists have found.
